biocs.name: JS Runtime Reading Git Credentials
biocs.description: A JavaScript runtime process attempts to read files in the .git directory, which is indicative of credential harvesting.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'node'
| filter action_file_path contains '.git'
| filter action_file_path contains 'credentials'

abiocs.name: Suspicious JS Runtime File Access
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a JavaScript runtime process accesses Git credential files, which is not typical for normal JS execution.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'node'
| filter action_file_path contains '.git'
| filter action_file_path contains 'credentials'

xql_queries.name: Detect JS Runtime Reading Git Credentials
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'node'
| filter action_file_path contains '.git'
| filter action_file_path contains 'credentials'
